channel.title: The Golf Channel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Pierceson Coody keeps top-25 streak going, tops Aon Swing 5 for Pebble, Genesis
item.description: Coody’s strong start to the season continued at the WM Phoenix Open, where the 26-year-old Coody tied for 10th. He will keep playing, too, as he qualified for his first two signature events via the Aon Swing 5.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: WM Phoenix Open, final round
item.description: Highlights from the final round of the 2026 WM Phoenix Open, where it took a sudden-death playoff to determine the winner at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am 2026: Odds, favorites for first signature event of the season
item.description: Rory McIlroy and Tommy Fleetwood make their 2026 PGA Tour debuts at the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro Am where they're projected to chase prohibitive favorite Scottie Scheffler.

item.title: Low Sooner: Chris Gotterup to world No. 5, best among Oklahoma alums all-time
item.description: Gotterup, who also captured the Sony Open last month and the WM Phoenix Open on Sunday, climbed nine spots, from No. 16 to No. 5.

item.title: Here's what LIV Golf's first world-rankings haul looked like
item.description: Elvis Smylie became the first player in league history to earn first-place points in the Official World Golf Ranking, jumping to world No. 77 in the process.

item.title: Should LIV Golf be happy with its OWGR allotment?
item.description: The Official World Golf Ranking is giving LIV Golf points for its top 10 finishers, beginning with this past week's season debut in Riyadh. Is this a good compromise or does LIV has reason to be upset? Brendan Porath and Shane Ryan join "Golf Today" to discuss.

item.title: Penske Performance: Driving powers Gotterup, fails Hideki in Phoenix
item.description: While driving helped lead Chris Gotterup to his second PGA Tour victory of the season, it was the reason Hideki Matsuyama didn't win his third WM Phoenix Open title. The Penske Performance numbers show why.

item.title: Could The Players make a major argument by going global?
item.description: As the debate re-emerges over The Players Championship being a major, Rex Hoggard and Eamon Lynch discuss if the PGA Tour should have its own major and if The Players could make a major statement by take the event abroad.

item.title: Thoughts on fans after spending a week at TPC Scottsdale
item.description: Ryan Lavner covered his first WM Phoenix Open this past week and got to experience the atmosphere first hand. He talks to Steve Burkowski on "Golf Central" about the fan behavior as well as Chris Gotterup's continued upward trajectory.

item.title: PGA Tour rookie records first hole-in-one in TGL history
item.description: The ace came off the club of Neal Shipley, the PGA Tour rookie who was debuting for The Bay Golf Club on Monday night at SoFi Center.
